digest.component_or_area: completion-recovery context bounds and close-gate messaging
propositions: A ticket whose text exceeds the 24,000-char context bound cannot reach closed status without --force-close despite correct merged work.
The step-budget failure path incorrectly reports 'install the agents extra' remedy after the verifier has already executed model calls, masking the true cause.
The criteria bound (32,000 chars) exceeds the context bound (24,000 chars), creating mutual incoherence where valid criteria sets are rejected at the context stage.
Compacting an over-cap context by eliding comment history silently deletes entire child tickets on epics while misreporting the loss as comment removal, creating a signed-false-pass vector.

The bounded recovery safeguard correctly fails fast with zero billable calls on breach, but the error messaging must report actual size against limit rather than delegating to a generic missing-extra remedy.
